Title: Rajesh and the Family

Cast

1. Rajesh - 31 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Shalini - 29 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Meenakshi - 29 years, friend
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Vikram - 29 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The bazaar - fruit stalls, a crowd

Scene 1: The bazaar - Day

[Rajesh stands in the bazaar. Vikram stands near him.]

Rajesh: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rajesh haggles with the shopkeeper.]

Rajesh (softly): "What next?"

[Rajesh pays the fruit seller.]

Rajesh: "And then?"

[Rajesh walks through the crowded bazaar.]

Vikram: "I really enjoyed today."
